about: Request unit, TF-FOLD + EXT-OWN (feat/eng-request-unit, NUMBER PENDING): the runtime lane reads a request's timeframe through 16 names and arms and through a no-argument script function's settled result; the chart's own symbol on the extended session is the chart's own daily bars on a daily chart, at the identity only. The plot lane reads as before. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: the plot lane is handed the runtime lane's reach (the confinement is gone)
the runtime lane's reach is back to the plot lane's 4 hops
mutants.from: const REQUEST_TF_REACH = Object.freeze({ hops: TF_READ_HOPS, calls: true })
mutants.to: const REQUEST_TF_REACH = Object.freeze({ hops: 4, calls: true })

mutants.mutant: a no-argument function's settled result is not read
mutants.from: const REQUEST_TF_REACH = Object.freeze({ hops: TF_READ_HOPS, calls: true })
mutants.to: const REQUEST_TF_REACH = Object.freeze({ hops: TF_READ_HOPS, calls: false })

mutants.mutant: a call's arguments are not its parameters (the body reads an empty frame)
mutants.from: this.frames.push(args.map((a) => ({ kind: 'expr', node: a.value, env: callerEnv })))

mutants.mutant: the runtime lane's resolvers are not given the reach
the extended-session ticker is not read as the chart's own daily bars
the extended-session ticker is read at another timeframe than the chart's own (a weekly read on a daily chart)
the extended-session ticker is folded onto an intraday chart's own bars
mutants.from: const extendedOwn = own === null && this.runtimeExtendedOwnDaily && this.basePeriod === 'D'

mutants.mutant: a literal prefix (another listing) is read as the chart's own
